firewall_enabled.description: Whether the firewall should be active after boot.

default_zone.description: Zone to apply by default to new network connections.

log_denied.description: Log level for denied packets. Options: off, unicast, broadcast, multicast, all.

rich_language_enabled.description: Enable support for firewalld's rich language for advanced rule expressions.

automatic_default_zone_updates.description: Automatically update the default zone when interfaces are added or removed.

services.description: List of services to allow in the default zone.

ports.description: List of ports (e.g., ['8080/tcp', '53/udp']) to allow in the default zone.

masquerade_enabled.description: Enable IP masquerading (NAT) for the default zone.

icmp_block_inheritance.description: Inherit ICMP blocks from the default zone configuration.

icmp_blocks.description: List of ICMP types to block (e.g., ['echo-request', 'router-solicitation']).

zones.description: Custom zone definitions (beyond the default zone). Each zone includes its name, allowed services, ports, masquerade setting, ICMP blocks, and ICMP inheritance flag.

icmp_blocks.description: ICMP types blocked in this zone.

icmp_block_inheritance.description: Enable ICMP block inheritance for this zone.

gui_enabled.description: Enable the firewall GUI configuration daemon (required for firewall-config tool).

gui_log_path.description: Path to the GUI log file.

debug_mode.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.
